query: What are the instruments in Horizon Europe (RIA, CSA, IA etc)?
response:
The primary funding instruments (called 'Action Types') in Horizon Europe define the nature of the project, its maturity level (TRL), and the applicable funding rules. The three core instruments are Research and Innovation Actions (RIA), Innovation Actions (IA), and Coordination and Support Actions (CSA).

Here is a summary of the main Horizon Europe Action Types:

### 1. Research and Innovation Actions (RIA)

| Aspect | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Focus** | Research, experimentation, and knowledge generation. Projects focus on establishing new knowledge and exploring novel technologies. |
| **TRL Range** | Low to Medium (Typically **TRL 2 – TRL 5**) |
| **Funding Rate** | **100%** of eligible costs (for all participant types) |
| **Typical Budget** | €3–8 million (Varies widely by topic) |
| **Proposal Page Limit** | 45 pages (for single-stage and two-stage full proposals) |

### 2. Innovation Actions (IA)

| Aspect | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Focus** | Demonstration, piloting, prototyping, and large-scale validation of technologies and solutions closer to market. |
| **TRL Range** | Medium to High (Typically **TRL 5 – TRL 8**) |
| **Funding Rate** | **70%** for for-profit entities (e.g., Large Companies, SMEs) and **100%** for non-profit entities (e.g., Universities, Research Institutes, NGOs). |
| **Typical Budget** | €5–15 million (Often larger, reflecting high demonstration costs) |
| **Proposal Page Limit** | 45 pages (for single-stage and two-stage full proposals) |

### 3. Coordination and Support Actions (CSA)

| Aspect | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Focus** | Networking, standardisation, dissemination, awareness-raising, and supporting research policy. CSAs do not typically fund research or demonstration themselves. |
| **TRL Range** | Not Applicable (N/A) |
| **Funding Rate** | **100%** of eligible costs (for all participant types) |
| **Typical Budget** | €1–3 million (Reflects networking and communication costs) |
| **Proposal Page Limit** | 30 pages |

***

### Other Key Instruments

Besides the main consortium-based actions (RIA/IA/CSA), Horizon Europe funds specific types of grants under Pillar I and Pillar III:

*   **ERC Grants (European Research Council):** Funds frontier research driven by a single Principal Investigator (PI).
*   **MSCA (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions):** Funds researcher mobility, training, and career development (e.g., Postdoctoral Fellowships, Doctoral Networks).
*   **EIC Accelerator (European Innovation Council):** Provides blended finance (grant + equity) for single SMEs with disruptive, market-creating innovations (TRL 6+).

### Standard Consortium Requirements

For most RIA, IA, and CSA calls, the minimum consortium requirement is:

> **3 independent legal entities from 3 different EU Member States or Associated Countries.**

***

### 🎯 Getting Started with Horizon Europe:

To find instruments relevant to your field, start here:

• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
